Accepted production explicit-ID source replacement; implementation scope only (2c73f3d9)

improvements: Replaced the shallow dish with a continuous deep top-house profile, observation glazing, lower glass base, three paired legs and the 200 ft tie.
Reprojected every declared base/top-house part from the complete current OSM source rings; complete beacon height is 184 m.
remainingGaps: Fine mullions, restaurant interior, current roof equipment and individual structural joints remain simplified.
Leg curvature, several profile break heights and facade colours remain authored estimates despite the verified overall height.
These are isolated front/top/oblique model studies, not matched street-eye Street View/aerial comparisons. They do not establish full-world, night, weather or seasonal parity.

The shared explicit-ID source-replacement implementation is integrated in production (2c73f3d986a4e52d85f5520ca6cb3d4b732f0d13). These studies retain their actual capture-era source and do not establish current district placement, road/body clearance, traffic/mirror budgets or seasonal parity. Registry entries outside a district list and context-only models with no replacement IDs do not replace neighbouring buildings.
